_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Saying v like w, th like s, and dropping the end of world

items.native: v 要用上齿轻咬下唇
items.gloss_en: For v, bite your lower lip with your top teeth.

items.native: th 舌尖伸到上下齿之间
items.gloss_en: For th, put your tongue between your teeth.

items.native: w 嘴唇要圆，不碰牙齿
items.gloss_en: For w, round your lips and do not touch your teeth.

items.native: 结尾的 ld 不要丢掉
items.gloss_en: Do not drop the ld at the end.

segments.text: Four words many learners say wrong. Listen, then repeat after me.

native.hook: 中国人常读错的 4 个单词
native.caption: “very”读成“wery”，“think”读成“sink”？这 4 个词最容易读错：“very”、“think”、“wine”和“world”。听 Carlos 老师示范，再在停顿时跟读。发音练习尽在 Lexkite 应用。

en.hook: 4 words Chinese learners often say wrong
en.caption: Do you say “very” as “wery” and “think” as “sink”? These 4 words are easy to get wrong: “very”, “think”, “wine” and “world”. Listen to teacher Carlos, then repeat in the pause. Pronunciation practice is in the Lexkite app.
